title: 第16章 也是遇上小师妹了
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
“是，不过小师妹你想做什么？”陆明薇不知道小师妹为什么会突然这么问。

    “没什么，就是想跟你确定一下师父的处理方式，放心，我不会让大师兄死的。”

    听到这儿，陆明薇有种不祥的预感。

    下一刻，只见小师妹跟身边的侍女说了什么，天一点头回应后直冲到谢长泽面前，“嘭”的一声，一拳砸在谢长泽脸上，直揍得人飞到半空又落到地上。

    偏偏天一受了微生璃月的吩咐，下手控制了力道，只让人受轻伤，能感觉到疼痛，但远远达不到晕过去的程度。

    “哐当。”

    “哐当。”

    空荡的院子里，月神殿内自带的桂花树下，微生璃月躺在天三给她准备的躺椅上，悠闲地欣赏着眼前的战斗。

    此时陆明薇和濮阳明珠已经在旁边的台阶上坐下，看着天一将大师兄一张俊俏脸庞揍得鼻青脸肿的场景，低声交流。

    “嘶，刚刚天一那一拳，我听着都有破风声，肯定很痛，你说是吧，四师妹。”陆明薇现在算是明白了师父再三叮嘱的苦心，她们小师妹，真的惹不得。

    “确实，幸好被打的人不是我们。”

    濮阳明珠点头如捣蒜，认同得不能再认同。

    小师妹这性子，谁要是惹了她，估计要被她给玩死，自己以后在小师妹面前，还是乖乖听话比较好。

    林不语跟天二去内门食堂大肆采购回来时，谢长泽依旧在被天一单方面当沙包揍。

    身为剑修，他到现在连个出剑的机会都没有，全程在挨揍。

    时间久了，身上自带的那股火焰气势湮灭不少。

    “小师妹，我和天二大人买完东西回来了，你们这是……”

    原本林不语正想着说自己买了好多好东西回来，小师妹肯定喜欢。

    结果刚进到院子，就看见一个熟悉的身影正单方面被天一大人当成沙包使。

    就是那脸，肿得跟猪头差不多。

    这真是他大师兄？模样也太惨了点。

    不过林不语不敢劝，既然是天一大人出的手，肯定是小师妹吩咐的，他绝不触小师妹霉头。
content_en:
"Yes, but what do you want to do, little junior sister?" Lu Mingwei didn't know why the junior sister suddenly asked this.

"It's nothing, I just want to confirm with you how master will deal with it. Don't worry, I won't let senior brother die."

Hearing this, Lu Mingwei had an ominous premonition.

The next moment, the junior sister said something to the maid beside her. Tian nodded and responded, then rushed straight in front of Xie Changze. With a "bang", he punched Xie Changze in the face, sending him flying into the air and falling to the ground.

However, Tianyi accepted Wei Sheng Liyue's instructions and controlled the force. He was only slightly injured and could feel pain, but it was far from the level of fainting.

"Clang."

"Clang."

In the empty yard, under the sweet-scented osmanthus tree that came with the Moon Temple, Liyue, a little girl, was lying on the recliner prepared for her by Tiansan, leisurely admiring the battle in front of her.

At this time, Lu Mingwei and Puyang Mingzhu had already sat down on the steps next to them, looking at the scene where Tianyi beat the senior brother's handsome face until it was bruised and swollen, and exchanged words in low voices.

"Hiss, I heard the sound of Tianyi's punch just now. It must be very painful, don't you think so, Fourth Junior Sister." Lu Mingwei now understood the painstaking efforts of the master's repeated warnings. They are really not to be messed with.

"Indeed, fortunately it was not us who were beaten."

Puyang Mingzhu nodded like garlic, agreeing so much that she couldn't agree more.

With Junior Sister's temper, anyone who offends her will probably be beaten to death by her. From now on, it would be better for me to be obedient in front of Junior Sister.

When Lin Buyu and Tian Er went to the Neimen Canteen to make purchases and returned, Xie Changze was still being beaten unilaterally by Tian Yi.

As a sword cultivator, he didn't even have a chance to draw his sword, and he was being beaten the whole time.

As time passed, the flame aura that came with his body was annihilated quite a bit.

"Little Junior Sister, Master Tianer and I have returned from shopping. What are you..."

Originally, Lin Buyu was thinking about saying that he had bought a lot of good things, and his junior sister would definitely like them.

As a result, as soon as he entered the courtyard, he saw a familiar figure being unilaterally used as a sandbag by Master Tianyi.

That face was as swollen as a pig's head.

Is this really his senior brother?It looked too miserable.

However, Lin Buyu didn't dare to dissuade him. Since it was Mr. Tianyi who took action, it must have been ordered by his junior sister. He would never touch her misfortune.
title_en: Chapter 16 I also met my junior sister
